Lemma
[complete ``only if'' direction from a partition of unity]

↗ lem:dc-ch0-5-6-hausdorff ↗ lem:dc-ch0-5-6-onlyif-pou

1. ch0:5.6Let $M$ be a connected manifold charted over a second-countable model $H$ admitting a differentiable partition of unity subordinate to a locally finite family of open, Hausdorff, $\sigma $-compact coordinate neighborhoods. Then $M$ is Hausdorff and has a countable basis.
Proof

\sketch

Immediate from section 4 (Hausdorff) and section 4 (countable basis), component by component.

□
